goal: Repair the Catalog Browse boundary behind equipment detail so only governed BrowseVariants become selectable, normal tracks expose only their maximum rank, and Mage browsing cannot receive type-unknown or cross-class armor.
userValue: When a player opens an equipment candidate, every visible option is a legal catalog choice for the selected class/spec; an imported player's lower-rank instance stays exact-only, and missing type or source proof removes the candidate rather than making the player decide whether it is trustworthy.
nonGoals: The user approved a Catalog repair after the Mage audit proved active Browse data leaks ExactItemInstances and type-unknown armor. Build and seal only a dormant Catalog v3 / Exact Registry candidate first; do not switch the active Catalog/Gear Release/Manifest pointer, ingest Battle.net data, run a source sync/backfill, alter Resolver rules/SimC compiler/TemplateSet/PostgreSQL schema, or mutate persisted player data.
Do not make Taro infer item attributes, source identity, type, class compatibility, or evidence status from opaque keys; the backend Catalog and public read model remain authoritative.

Do not treat the previously deployed 14078788 presentation candidate as valid for this expanded scope. It is superseded pending a new immutable candidate, targeted Catalog shadow, and explicit WeChat acceptance.

currentTruth.factOwner: CatalogRevision owns BrowseVariant membership and progression identity; ExactItemRegistry owns imported exact identities. Gear release/read-model serializers publish only their Catalog facts, and Taro consumes the public contract without inventing identity, type, class compatibility, or trust.

mustChange: The Catalog Builder must derive BrowseVariants exclusively from rowFamily browse. An ExactItemInstance may supply governed exact evidence where Track Authority explicitly allows it, but cannot create, extend, select, or supply the static facts of a public BrowseVariant.

Catalog v3 BrowseVariant identity must be catalogRevision, itemId, and progressionState without v2 shape identity. Each non-crafted normal progression has exactly one source shape at its bound maximum rank; a second shape blocks the dormant candidate rather than being public-compacted.

The Catalog candidate must explicitly exclude non-portable armor or weapon items lacking a verified governing type fact; the public WebSim compatibility boundary independently hides an unknown type or context-free tier candidate until a governed source repair exists.

A server-signed Exact template whose source variant is intentionally absent from Browse may retain that source identity only through a matching Exact Registry template reference. It must bind the same Catalog/Exact dependency vector, resolve through canonical authority, build a ready ResolvedLoadout, and compile canonical SimC input without publishing the exact source variant as a BrowseVariant.

The PG read-model/WebSim path must preserve existing specialization primary-stat, selected-variant, named progression, readable source, and safe diagnostic contracts for the remaining eligible Catalog candidates.

Targeted Builder, Track Authority, read-model/WebSim, Exact Registry, and Taro regressions must freeze Catalog membership, type eligibility, progression, primary-stat, selected-variant-display, source-label, trust, and diagnostic-sanitization contracts.
mustNotChange: Do not change the active catalog pointer, canonical Resolver legality/selection rules, SimC compiler semantics, source ingestion, timer state, or persisted data before the candidate release gate.
Do not relax fail-closed behavior for missing type, class, source, static-fact, or progression evidence; no frontend fallback or fabricated named drop source is allowed.
Do not alter active Taro geometry or replace the backend-owned Apply then Resolve flow.
riskUnknown: The active source snapshot can have non-portable equipment without verified armor/weapon type or a tier source without class context. This repair excludes/hides it, but does not manufacture or fetch a type fact.

A new Catalog v3 can reduce visible Browse coverage and can make Exact Registry replay partial/blocked for references that no longer map to public Browse. Its candidate shadow must report that result literally; it cannot reuse the old 40/40 claim.

The active Catalog contains multiple static-fact shapes for a logical progression state. Public projection must never select one arbitrarily; Catalog v3 must either publish one governed Browse source shape or block the dormant candidate.
Candidate runtime caches and the active WeChat bundle still require immutable candidate smoke, a dormant dependency-vector audit, and explicit manual acceptance before merge.
evidenceRequired: RED/GREEN targeted Python regressions proving ExactItemInstances do not seed Browse membership, one normal progression cannot hold two source shapes, v3 identity rejects duplicates, and missing equipment types/context cannot become selectable.

One real-code exact-only import regression must cover Exact projection, authority binding, canonical Resolve, ResolvedLoadout, and SimC profile compilation while proving the exact item remains absent from Browse membership.

Focused Catalog Builder/store, Track Authority, Exact Registry, release-store/read-model, WebSim payload, and existing selected-variant Taro suites; Harness requirement validation, diff review, and local CR tied to this one packet.

Before merge: deterministic dormant Catalog v3 / Exact Registry shadow, immutable candidate-head API/read-model smoke for Mage Arcane/Fire/Frost plus a valid cloth control, no active-pointer change, and explicit WeChat manual acceptance items below.

ownership.factOwner: server/gear_catalog_revision.py owns Catalog v3 Browse membership, one-state identity, and candidate exclusion accounting; server/gear_exact_item_registry.py owns ExactItemInstance identity; server/gear_release_store.py, server/pg_gear_read_model_selectors.py, and server/websim_payload.py preserve, specialize, and safely normalize those facts; apps/mini-taro/src/pages/builds/gear-detail-model.ts and gear-detail-editor-model.ts render returned public fields without deriving catalog identity.

engineeringHealth.reason: A user-visible public-payload regression originates in a hot Builder semantic boundary and crosses immutable Catalog, Exact Registry, read model, WebSim, and the active detail consumer. The repair narrows public Browse membership, retains archived v2 readability, uses TDD at each seam, seals only a dormant revision, and requires shadow/candidate/manual-acceptance gates before any pointer action.

acceptanceEvidence: A verified Catalog v3 item detail shows backend-owned static attributes instead of a blanket 待核验 state, but no type-unknown non-portable item is selectable.
A verified candidate shows a backend-owned named progression state rather than 难度待补; normal Browse tracks contain only their governed maximum rank and no observed-profile multiplicity.

If one logical progression has conflicting non-tertiary static facts or item levels, the dormant Catalog build is blocked and the active pointer is unchanged; the public payload never chooses a shape or asks the player to choose between conflicting rows.
For a selected legal variant, the detail summary includes the specialization-correct primary stat and changes to that variant's returned secondary facts before Apply.
A verified item source is a readable exact source label when an identity-matched snapshot record exists, otherwise a truthful source-type/difficulty fallback; no opaque key is shown as a name.

A verified Catalog item no longer displays Battle.net-only diagnostics merely because its static facts come from the active Manifest Catalog; a type-unknown candidate is hidden rather than presented with an invented type.

Mage Arcane, Fire, and Frost never receive 250033 or 268283 as selectable head candidates until their equipment type/class facts are governed; a valid cloth control remains selectable, and an imported Myth 2/6 instance remains exact-only.

A verified exact-only community import can resolve and compile with its exact item level, bonuses, and enhancements while the same exact source identity remains absent from public Browse membership; Catalog/Exact revision mismatch or partial exact evidence blocks the path.
No active pointer, source ingestion, persisted data, remote production runtime state, or UI geometry changes occur before final candidate acceptance.

decisionLog.decision: The user approved the original public-payload repair after verified Manifest static facts, source labels, and diagnostics were lost in equipment detail.

After real WeChat inspection exposed pending progression labels, repeated observed-profile shapes, missing primary stats, and stale selected-variant summaries, the user approved the Strict public-projection and selected-variant contract repair.

The Mage audit proved that the active Catalog v2 Builder promoted ExactItemInstance rows into Browse, retained a normal Myth 2/6 candidate, allowed multiple source shapes for Myth 6/6, and marked armorType-unknown heads compatible. The user confirmed the Catalog repair direction. This packet is extended rather than creating a second task packet on the same branch; the prior 14078788 presentation candidate is superseded.

The later current-HEAD review proved that exact-only recovery had become part of the implementation while the packet still forbade that semantic change. The user authorized end-to-end root-cause repair. This packet now explicitly covers only the sealed Exact import recovery needed by the Catalog correction; current-season PVE universe completeness and the 40-specialization real-WeChat matrix remain a subsequent independent Strict Harness phase and cannot be claimed by this packet.

harnessFindings.whatHappened: The first local repair restored source and static fact visibility but did not exercise real progression multiplicity, specialization primary-stat mapping, or selected-variant rerendering. WeChat inspection exposed all three gaps.
harnessFindings.missedGate: Impact Map and UI runtime evidence promotion
harnessFindings.impact: The candidate could not be accepted and required a second Strict public-contract repair before merge.
harnessFindings.recommendedAction: Keep the two real item IDs in the candidate smoke matrix and require compact progression, conflict, primary-stat, and selected-variant assertions before future public detail claims.

harnessFindings.whatHappened: The earlier public-projection repair treated duplicate progressions and missing type facts as presentation concerns. Mage browsing showed a selectable Exact Myth 2/6 item, a conflicting Myth 6/6 source shape, and head items with armorStatus unknown marked compatible.
harnessFindings.missedGate: Current Truth, Catalog ownership, and candidate API smoke matrix
harnessFindings.impact: The candidate cannot be accepted: the Catalog has crossed Exact/Browse ownership and public compatibility is no longer fail-closed for non-portable equipment.
harnessFindings.recommendedAction: Require a Builder-level exact-to-Browse exclusion, one-state v3 identity, type/context eligibility gate, dormant Catalog/Exact shadow, and Mage multi-spec smoke before any future gear detail candidate acceptance.
